text:
structure SimL (C : Contract) (L b : Nat) {Γ : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) (σ : State C []) (ρ : Look C Γ)
    (m : Machine) : Prop where
  store : ReprStore C L m.store σ.storage
  vals : ∀ {p : PrimTy} (i : Idx Γ (.val p)), ReprV p (ρ i) (m.memAt (lvl b i))
  aliases : ∀ {R : RefTy} (i : Idx Γ (.alias R)), F.get i = .ok →
    ∃ r s, ρ i = some r ∧ m.memAt (lvl b i) = .slot s ∧
      PathSlot C true r s
  /-- `net(a)` is what `a`'s account lost, at every address but the
  contract's own. -/
  net : ∀ a : Fin W, a ≠ m.self → netAt σ.net a.1 = (m.bal₀ a : Int) - m.bal a
  /-- The contract's own entry is never moved. -/
  netSelf : netAt σ.net m.self = 0
  /-- The bound on the arrays is at most solc's. -/
  bound : L ≤ Lmax
  /-- A fragile alias: its cell holds the slot of a path that indexes an
  array, and that path is in bounds. -/
  fragile : ∀ {R : RefTy} (i : Idx Γ (.alias R)), F.get i = .fragile →
    ∃ r s, ρ i = some r ∧ m.memAt (lvl b i) = .slot s ∧
      PathSlot C false r s ∧
      ∃ sv, σ.storage.findLive r = some sv
  /-- `msg.sender`, `msg.value`, `block.timestamp`, `address(this)`. -/
  env : EnvSim σ.tx m
  /-- The contract's spendable balance agrees with the machine. -/
  funds : σ.selfBalance.1 = m.bal m.self
  /-- Both readings accept the same external payment. -/
  oracle : ∀ (addr amt : PrimTy.uint.Denote) (x y : Fin W),
    addr.1 = x.1 → amt.1 = y.1 →
    (match Semantics.lookupBy (sendKey addr amt) σ.tx.ext with
      | none | some (.ok _) => true | some _ => false) = m.accepts x y

def Input {b : Nat} {Γ Δ : Ctx} {F : Frag Γ} {P : Prog C Γ Δ}
    (result : Compilation b F P) (L frame : Nat) (base : Nat → Fin W)
    (σ : State C Γ) (m : Machine) : Prop :=
  match result with
  | .core _ _ => Sim C L b F σ m ∧ L + Evm.Prog.pushes P ≤ Lmax
  | .memory out => Memory.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧ b + Memory.frameNeedProg P ≤ frame ∧
      Memory.AllocationInput b frame (out.cert.cost σ) σ base m
  | .referenceArrays _ => Memory.RefArrayStateRepr L b frame F σ base m
  | .objects _ => Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + Memory.frameNeedProg P ≤ frame
  | .construction _ => Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + Memory.frameNeedProg P ≤ frame ∧
      Memory.Objects.AllocationInput b frame (Memory.Construction.allocationCostProg P σ) σ base m
  | .memoryLoops out => Memory.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + out.cert.need ≤ frame ∧ Memory.Loops.Room out.cert frame σ base m
  | .memoryLoopScopes out => Memory.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + out.cert.need ≤ frame ∧ Memory.LoopScopes.Room out.cert frame σ base m
  | .memoryCalls out _ => Memory.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧ b + out.need ≤ frame ∧
      Memory.AllocationInput b frame (out.cost σ) σ base m
  | .memoryCopy out => Memory.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + Memory.frameNeedProg P ≤ frame ∧
      Memory.AllocationInput b frame (out.cert.cost σ) σ base m ∧
      Memory.copyBoundProg P σ ≤ L
  | .fixedMemory _ => Memory.FixedStateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧ Memory.copyBoundProg P σ ≤ L
  | .copyConstruction _ => Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame F σ base m ∧
      b + Memory.frameNeedProg P ≤ frame ∧
      Memory.Objects.AllocationInput b frame (Memory.Construction.allocationCostProg P σ) σ base m ∧
      Memory.copyBoundProg P σ ≤ L

def Rep {b : Nat} {Γ Δ : Ctx} {F : Frag Γ} {P : Prog C Γ Δ}
    (result : Compilation b F P) (L frame : Nat) (base : Nat → Fin W)
    (entry : State C Γ) (initial : Machine) (σ : State C Δ) (m : Machine) : Prop :=
  match result with
  | .core out _ => Sim C L b out σ m
  | .memory out => ∃ base', Memory.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧
      Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.GrowsAllocator b frame (out.cert.cost entry) entry base initial σ base' m
  | .referenceArrays out => Memory.RefArrayStateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base m
  | .objects out => Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base m ∧
      Memory.Objects.KeepsAllocator b frame entry base initial σ m
  | .construction out => ∃ base', Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧
      Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.Objects.GrowsAllocator b frame (Memory.Construction.allocationCostProg P entry)
        entry base initial σ base' m
  | .memoryLoops out => ∃ base' cost, ∃ e : entry.H <+: σ.H,
      Memory.Loops.Cost out.cert entry ⟨σ, e⟩ cost ∧
      Memory.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧ Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.GrowsAllocator b frame cost entry base initial σ base' m
  | .memoryLoopScopes out => ∃ base' cost, ∃ e : entry.H <+: σ.H,
      Memory.LoopScopes.Cost out.cert entry ⟨σ, e⟩ cost ∧
      Memory.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧ Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.GrowsAllocator b frame cost entry base initial σ base' m
  | .memoryCalls out _ => ∃ base', Memory.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧
      Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.GrowsAllocator b frame (out.cost entry) entry base initial σ base' m
  | .memoryCopy out => ∃ base', Memory.StateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base' m ∧
      Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.GrowsAllocator b frame (out.cert.cost entry) entry base initial σ base' m
  | .fixedMemory out => Memory.FixedStateRepr L b frame out.frag σ base m ∧
      m.mem = initial.mem ∧ σ.H = entry.H ∧ HEq σ.heap entry.heap

  | .copyConstruction _ => ∃ base', Memory.Objects.StateRepr L b frame result.frag σ base' m ∧
      Memory.BaseExtends entry.H base base' ∧
      Memory.Objects.GrowsAllocator b frame (Memory.Construction.allocationCostProg P entry)
        entry base initial σ base' m

def Agrees {b : Nat} {Γ Δ : Ctx} {F : Frag Γ} {P : Prog C Γ Δ}
    (result : Compilation b F P) (L frame : Nat) (base : Nat → Fin W)
    (σ : State C Γ) (m : Machine) : Prop :=
  (∃ o m', P.run σ = .ok o ∧ run result.code m = .ok m' 0 ∧ m'.stack = m.stack ∧
    result.Rep (L + Evm.Prog.pushes P) frame base σ m o.st m') ∨
  ((P.run σ = .error .revert ∨ (P.asserts = true ∧ P.run σ = .error .panic)) ∧
    run result.code m = .revert) ∨
  (Evm.Prog.pays P = true ∧ run result.code m = .revert ∧ ∃ o m',
    P.run σ = .ok o ∧ result.Rep (L + Evm.Prog.pushes P) frame base σ m o.st m') ∨
  (P.run σ = .error .diverge ∧ (run result.code m = .fault ∨
    (Evm.Prog.pays P = true ∧ run result.code m = .revert)))

text:
def inFrag {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : Solidity.Stmt C Γ Γ' → Option (Frag Γ')
  | .assign l r => F.guard (assignIn F r l)
  | .rebind i r => match r with
    | .path q => (bindFl F q).map (F.set i)
    | .push .. => none
  | .assignLocal _ r => F.guard (valIn F r)
  | .declLocal p _ init => (F.push (.val p) .ok).guard (init.all (valIn F))
  | .declStorage R _ init => declStorageIn F R init
  | .opAssign _ _ _ l r => F.guard (opLocIn F l && valIn F r)
  | .incDec _ _ l => F.guard (opLocIn F l)
  | .assignIncDec _ _ _ l _ => F.guard (opLocIn F l)
  | .push b v _ => F.guard (pushIn F v b)
  | .pop b => F.dropFragile.guard (spathIn F false b)
  | .transfer r a => F.guard (valIn F r && valIn F a)
  | @Solidity.Stmt.delete _ _ T l => F.dropFragile.guard (leavesFit T && locIn F false l)
  | .ite c t e =>
    if valIn F c then
      match inFragP F t, inFragP F e with
      | some F₁, some F₂ => some ((F₁.restrict Γ).meet (F₂.restrict Γ))
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  | .block body => (inFragP F body).map (Frag.restrict Γ)
  | .require c | .assert c => F.guard (valIn F c)
  | .revert => some F
  | .assumeFalse => none
  | @Solidity.Stmt.call _ _ _ ps rs _ _ args ret body =>
    if argsIn F args then
      match inFragP (Frag.init (rs ++ ps)) body with
      | some _ => CallRetIn (F.after (Prog.shrinks body)) ret
      | none => none
    else none
  -- a loop whose body pushes, pays, shrinks nothing and leaves what is known
  -- of the locals as it found it: every turn starts from the same fragment
  | .loop _ c body =>
    if valIn F c && Prog.pushes body == 0 && !Prog.pays body && !Prog.shrinks body then
      match inFragP F body with
      | some G => if (G.restrict Γ).fl = F.fl then some F else none
      | none => none
    else none
  | .assignLocalPush .. | .send .. | .declMem .. | .rebindMem .. | .assignFromMem ..
  | .assignMem .. | .deleteMem ..
  | .assignNew .. | .tryCall .. | .revertData _ | .catchData .. | .pushOpAssign .. | .pushIncDec ..
  | .callReceiver .. => none
  | .callReceiverPush .. => none
  -- recursion is outside the compiled fragment
  | .callRec .. => none
/-- A block of the fragment. -/
def inFragP {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (F : Frag Γ) : Solidity.Prog C Γ Γ' → Option (Frag Γ')
  | .nil => some F
  | .cons s P => match inFrag F s with
    | some F' => inFragP F' P
    | none => none
end

def Premise.Sound (m : Modality) {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Γ') (p : Premise C Γ Γ')
    (σ : State C Γ) : Prop :=
  ∀ {Γ₁ Γ₀ : Ctx} (ω : Prog C Γ' Γ₁) (κ : Frames C Γ₁ Γ₀) (φ : Fml C Γ₀),
    holds σ (p.fml m ω κ φ) → holds σ (.modal m (.cons s ω) κ φ)

/-- **Every rule the strategy fires is sound** over the typed state, in
every typed state, at any fresh index (`Stmt.Sound`, over `State`). -/
def Stmt.Sound (C : Contract) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (m : Modality) {Γ Γ' : Ctx} (s : Stmt C Γ Γ') (p : Premise C Γ Γ'),
    s.step k m = p → ∀ σ : State C Γ, Premise.Sound m s p σ

def holdsC (I : Fml C []) (pay : Bool) : {Γ : Ctx} → State C Γ → Fml C Γ → Prop
  | _, _, .tt => True
  | _, σ, .eq a b => holds σ (.eq a b)
  | _, σ, .wellFormed t => holds σ (.wellFormed t)
  | _, σ, .not φ => ¬ holdsC I pay σ φ
  | _, σ, .and φ ψ => holdsC I pay σ φ ∧ holdsC I pay σ ψ
  | _, σ, .imp φ ψ => holdsC I pay σ φ → holdsC I pay σ ψ
  | _, σ, .upd m U φ => U.afterT m σ (holdsC I pay · φ)
  | _, σ, .modal m P κ φ =>
    ∀ o, ExecP (I.stateInv pay) σ P o → o.thenF (I.stateInv pay) κ m (holdsC I pay · φ)
  | _, σ, .havoc φ => ∀ st nt sb, holdsC I pay (σ.havoc st nt sb) φ
  | _, σ, .all _ p φ => ∀ v : p.Denote, holdsC I pay (σ.push (t := .val p) v) φ
  | _, σ, .bind m _ t φ => m.forallB fun v : t.TDenote C σ.H => holdsC I pay (σ.push v) φ
  | _, σ, .anon xs φ => ∀ b, holdsC I pay (σ.anon xs b) φ
  | _, σ, .allocAll _ A φ => ∀ o : MObj σ.H A,
      holdsC I pay ((σ.alloc o).1.push (t := .mem A) (some (σ.alloc o).2)) φ
  | _, σ, .grow φ => ∀ g : Grown σ.H (fun _ => Unit), Heap.Keeps g.ext σ.heap g.heap →
      holdsC I pay (σ.adopt g).1 φ

/-- A first-order formula has no program, so no payment. -/
